travelerQuestions.title: Traveler questions
travelerQuestions.answerHint: We can answer most questions right away
travelerQuestions.qualityDesc: Based on guest reviews, visitors especially highlight the clean and tidy accommodation, the quiet location in central Daruvar, and the hosts' hospitality. Below are answers to the most common questions.

parking.q: Does the property offer free parking?
parking.a: Yes, all guests have free access to private parking next to the property.

breakfast.q: Is breakfast served at the property?
breakfast.a: Breakfast is not included in the room rate. Cafés and restaurants with morning menus are nearby.

wifi.a: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and common areas.

therms.q: How far are the Daruvar thermal baths?
therms.a: The Daruvar thermal baths are within a few minutes' walk of the property.

attractions.a: Nearby you'll find Janković Castle park, Daruvar thermal baths, the Church of the Holy Three Kings and the city centre.

pets.a: Pets are not allowed at the property.

checkin.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkin.a: Check-in is from 14:00 to 23:00, and check-out from 09:00 to 11:00. Arrival times can be arranged by agreement.

wellness.q: Does the property have wellness (sauna, jacuzzi)?
wellness.a: Yes, guests can use the wellness area with sauna and jacuzzi.

families.a: Yes, some rooms accommodate up to 4 guests and are suitable for families.

booking.q: How can I book a room?
booking.a: You can submit a booking request via the Booking page form or contact us by email and phone.
